title: A Better Man
lyrics:
Pssss listen to me for a minute or five
I wanna share some life changing light
Reaching for the dark corners we hide
No more shadows creeping with demon holds
All truths exposed then explained why
Take a seat and wait for your story to die

Now is the time
For my first time
I do not want to die

Said fuck that dream
How to stay alive
Find a better man in me

Looking ahead past all the yesterday's
Fuck the history writing tomorrows Fate
It's now time to loosen the hateful gripp
Flush out the hurt that grew from birth
Give into a conceited self worship
Silence the degrading screams inside my head

Now is the time
For my first time
I do not want to die

Said fuck that dream
How to stay alive
Find a better man in me

Stepping blindly into the unknown life
Watching everything held close dieing
A new start to this blank slate of mirrors
Impeding reflections none of them seem right
What flowering dreams do we reach for
Is there an achievable move to be made

Now is the time

treatment:
# A Better Man — creative treatment

#WEED_SMOK · June 11, 2025

## Song and dramatic shape

Decoded audio: 304.88 seconds. Spectral-flux analysis suggests an approximately 88.24 BPM main pulse with a 176.47 BPM double-time interpretation. Beat positions and bass/impact envelopes are measured; tempo is an estimate. The supplied words describe facing inherited pain, choosing survival, rebuilding identity and remaining present as a father. Instrument labels and emotional readings are creative interpretation, not an automatic certainty claim.

## Direction — Fragments / Becoming Whole

The artist moves from a room of fractured mirrors through an exposed industrial landscape and suspended reflections, toward an ordinary human connection. The supplied mirrored-mosaic portrait becomes a serious visual metaphor for an identity made of pieces. It does not turn the song into a disco scene. The real portrait anchors recognition and the closing resolution.

Palette: obsidian, cold silver, midnight blue and deep burgundy; subdued warm daylight enters with the fatherhood verse. Grade and exposure stay consistent across images. Use multiple genuine generated images for every major setting, including wide space, material detail and reference-based artist compositions. Anonymous back-facing adult/child silhouettes depict fatherhood symbolically; no fabricated child is presented as a real family member.

Typography: Barlow Condensed Black/Bebas Neue for clear forceful declarations, with Cormorant Garamond used sparingly for vulnerable bridge phrases. Controlled word emphasis follows measured impacts and vocal cues. Strong resting frames, ample safe margins and no flashing chaos.

Dramatic moments: intro assembles the artist identity and generated title; each refrain gains spatial and typographic scale; the mirrors verse turns the setting into a field of suspended panels; the bridge strips toward nearly empty space; the instrumental interval develops material and portrait imagery without invented lyrics; the fatherhood verse changes to intimate daylight; the final declarations resolve toward an intact portrait and a matching generated end title.

Transitions match reflective edges and light direction, pass through foreground glass, and dissolve through atmospheric gaps. Camera movement uses opposing depth layers and restrained pushes; no simulated singing performance is claimed. Finish with subtle deterministic grain, limited light bloom and motion trails only where motion supports them.

## Builder decisions and alternatives

Use the existing local React/Remotion/FFmpeg studio and reusable timeline/editor. This avoids external service charges and keeps projects recoverable. Generated stills plus procedural motion provide directed image sequences with exact lyric/control layers. Fully generated video would add unavailable cost and continuity risk; a typography-only visualizer would underuse the supplied artist imagery. The existing user instruction delegates sensible artistic/technical decisions, so this treatment is a revisable director's choice. A concise optional approval/revision prompt has been presented while V2 renders.

Preserve every supplied lyric token, including spelling and profanity. Use local transcription for vocal evidence and CTC alignment for supplied words; flag uncertain boundaries and disagreements. Do not silently add omitted ad-libs or replace text with guessed transcription. Preserve full original audio without normalization unless actual clipping requires it.

Deliver a full 16:9 1080p H.264/AAC MP4, editable project/source/assets/fonts/licenses, SRT, representative frames and final-file QC. Publish in a separate folder/branch of the authorized existing Lyricforge repository, preserving earlier productions.
